title: Erdős's conjecture on 5-cycles in triangle-free graphs
statement: Let $G$ be a triangle-free graph on $n$ vertices. **Erdős's conjecture.** The graph $G$ contains at most $(n/5)^5$ cycles of length $5$. The balanced blow-up of the $5$-cycle $C_5$ attains this bound when $n$ is divisible by $5$, but the source gives no resolution of the conjecture.
source_name: Jorik Jooken, “Computer-assisted graph theory: a survey”, arXiv:2508.20825 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.20825

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of August 2025).
